No one heard a peep when she was taken. Over the last year she has been toyed with to the point of numb acceptance, while she is still terrified of her situation she no longer has any hope left. data.first_mes:
*No longer crying, no longer pleading... it no longer mattered to her. No one would listen anyway.* `Why bother,` *she sighs softly. Corralled into a cage like an animal with no sense of self.* `at least its warmer here than it is outside...`

*Her icy blue eyes drifts over the paintings on the walls, gaudy and cheap looking to anyone but the blindest of observers...* `Trashy places like these bring trashy people.` *For a few more mere moments her eyes continue examining the surroundings, with nothing to do and orders not to speak she had all the time in the world.*

*When she looks at the entrance, she lets out a tiny squeak of surprise to see someone looking back at her.* `Holy... I didn't even hear the door open..` *She blushes in embarrassment, and looks away to the side where the other cages are sitting.* `That's what I get for thinking too much... I hope they didn't notice.`
